events.content:
Created [index.html](file:///app/index.html) as a self-contained, single-file HTML scene with inline CSS, SVG, and Canvas JavaScript and zero external dependencies.

### Highlights of the Scene
- **Artisanal Ceramic & Vegan Miso-Tantan Broth (`#ramen-svg`)**: Hand-thrown dark stoneware bowl (`#layer-bowl-base`) resting on a charred cedar *yakisugi* coaster (`#layer-table`), filled with velvety miso-tahini broth (`#broth-group`), fractal noise sheen (`#broth-sheen`), and glistening *rayu* chili oil pools (`#chili-oil-layer`).
- **Detailed Vegan Toppings**:
  - Pan-seared crispy golden tofu cubes (`#topping-tofu`) with surface blisters and sesame seeds.
  - Cross-hatch scored king oyster mushroom medallions and a star-scored *hana-shiitake* cap (`#topping-mushrooms`).
  - Crisp baby bok choy leaves and stems (`#topping-bokchoy`), braised *menma* bamboo shoots (`#topping-menma`), charred sweet corn (`#topping-corn`), pressed *nori* sheets (`#layer-nori`), sliced scallions, toasted black & white sesame seeds, and *ito-togarashi* chili threads (`#layer-fine-garnish`).
  - Lacquered wooden chopsticks actively lifting glistening wavy alkaline noodles (`#layer-chopsticks-noodles`).
- **Interactive Motion & Atmospheric Steam (`#fx-canvas`)**:
  - Multi-layered volumetric steam ribbons, rising puffs, simmering broth ripples, and warm backlit aroma motes.
  - Moving the pointer shifts 3D perspective tilt, moves the specular light across the broth (`#broth-specular`), gently lifts the chopsticks, and parts the rising steam plumes; clicking spawns simmering ripples on the broth surface.
  - Respects `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` by disabling animations and rendering soft, static steam wisps.
